scope: The exact five retained synthetic vector sets, plus the existing 207 packet tests; no arbitrary fuzzing, native process, chain state, keys, user runtime fixtures, or network bridge.
reviewed_boundary: Each Machine dispatches a finite explicit instruction set; unknown instruction, unknown code address and unknown external call fail.

Loads/stores operate on synthetic Arena memory; permitted constant reads use authenticated local ELF rodata. Host hooks implement recorded hash/map/allocation/recorder contracts rather than launching target code.
No syscall, ctypes native bridge, socket or HTTP dispatch exists in these evaluator paths. The unit-conversion test subprocess invokes its local Python producer, not the node.
Original loops retain instruction limits and finite vector lists. The fresh wrapper adds memory and nested-call caps; the parent subprocess adds a 900-second wall cap per packet.
